ModMetaData.name: Filter Signals
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
See what this colony can produce directly inside RimWorld item filters.
Compact status squares distinguish producible, unlocked, locked, and unavailable items. Click a square to jump to a usable workstation, relevant research, or an Architect option when one exists. The optional toolbar is hidden by default, and view filtering never changes saved allow or deny choices.
